svg.aria-label: SYNTHWERK_PULSE_DATABASE_URL: Postgres URL. Required. A secret: never in the repo. SYNTHWERK_PULSE_NATS_URL: NATS JetStream URL. SYNTHWERK_PULSE_TARGETS_FILE: The targets file. Read at start. SYNTHWERK_PULSE_HTTP_ADDR: Listen address. Default :8080. SYNTHWERK_PULSE_DEFAULT_INTERVAL: Check interval. Default 15s. 1 s to 5 min. SYNTHWERK_PULSE_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT: Check timeout. Default 3s. Max the interval and 10 s. SYNTHWERK_PULSE_SSE_MAX_CLIENTS: Max open streams. Default 50
